# Game Concept: [Title]

> Date: · Status: · Platforms: [desktop web, mobile web, PWA]

## 1. Pitch
One sentence plus a paragraph.

## 2. Core loop
Action → obstacle → reward → progression; session length; what brings players back.

## 3. MDA
Mechanics → dynamics → aesthetics (what the player feels).

## 4. Key mechanics
List with rules and parameters (in data, not code).

## 5. Progression and economy
Resources, sources/sinks, difficulty curve (table), monetisation (if any).

## 6. Content and volume
Levels/entities/assets for the MVP vs the full version.

## 7. Visuals and audio
References, style, palette, audio palette; licences.

## 8. Technical feasibility
Engine (three.js / Pixi / Phaser / Babylon) and why; frame/memory/load budget on mobile web; networking (single-player / server-authoritative); saves; risks and spikes to verify them.

## 9. Accessibility
Remapping, subtitles, UI scale, colour-blind mode, pause, pacing.

## 10. Metrics
Retention D1/D7, session length, first-level funnel.

## 11. Prototype
What we validate by playability first, timeline, the "is it fun" criterion.
